record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764> upon Shoshannim<WH07799>, <FI>A Psalm<Fi> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> Save<WH03467><WTH8685> me, O God<WH0430>; for the waters<WH04325> are come<WH0935><WTH8804> in unto <FI>my<Fi> soul<WH05315>.

I sink<WH02883><WTH8804> in deep<WH04688> mire<WH03121>, where <FI>there is<Fi> no standing<WH04613>: I am come<WH0935><WTH8804> into deep<WH04615> waters<WH04325>, where the floods<WH07641> overflow<WH07857><WTH8804> me. <RF>deep mire: Heb. the mire of depth<Rf> <RF>deep waters: Heb. depth of waters<Rf>

I am weary<WH03021><WTH8804> of my crying<WH07121><WTH8800>: my throat<WH01627> is dried<WH02787><WTH8738>: mine eyes<WH05869> fail<WH03615><WTH8804> while I wait<WH03176><WTH8764> for my God<WH0430>.

They that hate<WH08130><WTH8802> me without a cause<WH02600> are more<WH07231><WTH8804> than the hairs<WH08185> of mine head<WH07218>: they that would destroy<WH06789><WTH8688> me, <FI>being<Fi> mine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802> wrongfully<WH08267>, are mighty<WH06105><WTH8804>: then I restored<WH07725><WTH8686> <FI>that<Fi> which I took not away<WH01497><WTH8804>.
O God<WH0430>, thou knowest<WH03045><WTH8804> my foolishness<WH0200>; and my sins<WH0819> are not hid<WH03582><WTH8738> from thee. <RF>sins: Heb. guiltiness<Rf>

Let not them that wait<WH06960><WTH8802> on thee, O Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069> of hosts<WH06635>, be ashamed<WH0954><WTH8799> for my sake: let not those that seek<WH01245><WTH8764> thee be confounded<WH03637><WTH8735> for my sake, O God<WH0430> of Israel<WH03478>.
Because for thy sake I have borne<WH05375><WTH8804> reproach<WH02781>; shame<WH03639> hath covered<WH03680><WTH8765> my face<WH06440>.
I am become a stranger<WH02114><WTH8716> unto my brethren<WH0251>, and an alien<WH05237> unto my mother's<WH0517> children<WH01121>.
For the zeal<WH07068> of thine house<WH01004> hath eaten me up<WH0398><WTH8804>; and the reproaches<WH02781> of them that reproached<WH02778><WTH8802> thee are fallen<WH05307><WTH8804> upon me.
When I wept<WH01058><WTH8799>, <FI>and chastened<Fi> my soul<WH05315> with fasting<WH06685>, that was to my reproach<WH02781>.
I made<WH05414><WTH8799> sackcloth<WH08242> also my garment<WH03830>; and I became a proverb<WH04912> to them.

They that sit in<WH03427><WTH8802> the gate<WH08179> speak<WH07878><WTH8799> against me; and I <FI>was<Fi> the song<WH05058> of the drunkards<WH08354><WTH8802><WH07941>. <RF>drunkards: Heb. drinkers of strong drink<Rf><CM>

But as for me, my prayer<WH08605> <FI>is<Fi> unto thee, O LORD<WH03068>, <FI>in<Fi> an acceptable<WH07522> time<WH06256>: O God<WH0430>, in the multitude<WH07230> of thy mercy<WH02617> hear<WH06030><WTH8798> me, in the truth<WH0571> of thy salvation<WH03468>.

Deliver<WH05337><WTH8685> me out of the mire<WH02916>, and let me not sink<WH02883><WTH8799>: let me be delivered<WH05337><WTH8735> from them that hate<WH08130><WTH8802> me, and out of the deep<WH04615> waters<WH04325>.

Let not the waterflood<WH04325><WH07641> overflow<WH07857><WTH8799> me, neither let the deep<WH04688> swallow me up<WH01104><WTH8799>, and let not the pit<WH0875> shut<WH0332><WTH8799> her mouth<WH06310> upon me.

Hear<WH06030><WTH8798> me, O LORD<WH03068>; for thy lovingkindness<WH02617> <FI>is<Fi> good<WH02896>: turn<WH06437><WTH8798> unto me according to the multitude<WH07230> of thy tender mercies<WH07356>.

And hide<WH05641><WTH8686> not thy face<WH06440> from thy servant<WH05650>; for I am in trouble<WH06887><WTH8804>: hear<WH06030><WTH8798> me speedily<WH04118>. <RF>hear...: Heb. make haste to hear me<Rf>
Draw nigh<WH07126><WTH8798> unto my soul<WH05315>, <FI>and<Fi> redeem<WH01350><WTH8798> it: deliver<WH06299><WTH8798> me because of mine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>.
Thou hast known<WH03045><WTH8804> my reproach<WH02781>, and my shame<WH01322>, and my dishonour<WH03639>: mine adversaries<WH06887><WTH8802> <FI>are<Fi> all before thee.

Reproach<WH02781> hath broken<WH07665><WTH8804> my heart<WH03820>; and I am full of heaviness<WH05136><WTH8799>: and I looked<WH06960><WTH8762> <FI>for some<Fi> to take pity<WH05110><WTH8800>, but <FI>there was<Fi> none; and for comforters<WH05162><WTH8764>, but I found<WH04672><WTH8804> none. <RF>to take...: Heb. to lament with me<Rf>
They gave<WH05414><WTH8799> me also gall<WH07219> for my meat<WH01267>; and in my thirst<WH06772> they gave me vinegar<WH02558> to drink<WH08248><WTH8686>.<CM>
Let their table<WH07979> become a snare<WH06341> before<WH06440> them: and <FI>that which should have been<Fi> for <FI>their<Fi> welfare<WH07965>, <FI>let it become<Fi> a trap<WH04170>.
Let their eyes<WH05869> be darkened<WH02821><WTH8799>, that they see<WH07200><WTH8800> not; and make their loins<WH04975> continually<WH08548> to shake<WH04571><WTH8685>.
Pour out<WH08210><WTH8798> thine indignation<WH02195> upon them, and let thy wrathful<WH02740> anger<WH0639> take hold<WH05381><WTH8686> of them.

Let their habitation<WH02918> be desolate<WH08074><WTH8737>; <FI>and<Fi> let none dwell<WH03427><WTH8802> in their tents<WH0168>. <RF>their habitation: Heb. their palace<Rf> <RF>let none...: Heb. let there not be a dweller<Rf>

For they persecute<WH07291><WTH8804> <FI>him<Fi> whom thou hast smitten<WH05221><WTH8689>; and they talk<WH05608><WTH8762> to the grief<WH04341> of those whom thou hast wounded<WH02491>. <RF>those...: Heb. thy wounded<Rf>
Add<WH05414><WTH8798> iniquity<WH05771> unto their iniquity<WH05771>: and let them not come<WH0935><WTH8799> into thy righteousness<WH06666>. <RF>iniquity unto...: or, punishment of iniquity, etc<Rf>
Let them be blotted<WH04229><WTH8735> out of the book<WH05612> of the living<WH02416>, and not be written<WH03789><WTH8735> with the righteous<WH06662>.
But I <FI>am<Fi> poor<WH06041> and sorrowful<WH03510><WTH8802>: let thy salvation<WH03444>, O God<WH0430>, set me up on high<WH07682><WTH8762>.<CM>
I will praise<WH01984><WTH8762> the name<WH08034> of God<WH0430> with a song<WH07892>, and will magnify<WH01431><WTH8762> him with thanksgiving<WH08426>.

<FI> This<Fi> also shall please<WH03190><WH00> the LORD<WH03068> better<WH03190><WTH8799> than an ox<WH07794> <FI>or<Fi> bullock<WH06499> that hath horns<WH07160><WTH8688> and hoofs<WH06536><WTH8688>.

The humble<WH06035> shall see<WH07200><WTH8804> <FI>this, and<Fi> be glad<WH08055><WTH8799>: and your heart<WH03824> shall live<WH02421><WTH8799> that seek<WH01875><WTH8802> God<WH0430>. <RF>humble: or, meek<Rf>
For the LORD<WH03068> heareth<WH08085><WTH8802> the poor<WH034>, and despiseth<WH0959><WTH8804> not his prisoners<WH0615>.
Let the heaven<WH08064> and earth<WH0776> praise<WH01984><WTH8762> him, the seas<WH03220>, and every thing that moveth<WH07430><WTH8802> therein. <RF>moveth: Heb. creepeth<Rf>

For God<WH0430> will save<WH03467><WTH8686> Zion<WH06726>, and will build<WH01129><WTH8799> the cities<WH05892> of Judah<WH03063>: that they may dwell<WH03427><WTH8804> there, and have it in possession<WH03423><WTH8804>.
The seed<WH02233> also of his servants<WH05650> shall inherit<WH05157><WTH8799> it: and they that love<WH0157><WTH8802> his name<WH08034> shall dwell<WH07931><WTH8799> therein.<CM>
